payload.text: hv's rulings during devbin 0.1.23's third cut (release commit c13c101a, reset by hv to dc0e45b8 at 09:35Z), 2026-11-12, read by date -u. (1) In vc's window, received between 09:06Z and 09:07Z, hv's wording: 'Note: [another estate's] rust work needs to be behind devbin and intent work today. Just so you know.' The desk grants another estate's cargo runs only in a gap, when no devbin or Intent run is going on rhadamanth or kovacs and the load allows. That estate's vc and its asking session were told at 09:07Z. The asking session withdrew its queued ask, which the desk denied as withdrawn. (2) In kovacs-sysadm's window, relayed by kovacs-sysadm before 09:31Z, hv's wording: 'cancelled and fixed IMMEDIATELY'. kovacs-sysadm stopped the cut's kovacs leg at 09:28:29Z, after 1230 tests. Its one not ok was 1150, harness.bats:198, whose unbounded "$DEVBIN_HOME"* guard reads 0334's <worktree>.tmp TMPDIR as inside the checkout. (3) In vc's window, received between 09:26Z and 09:31Z, hv's wording: 'WHAT THE HELL ARE THESE DAMN SLEEPS!? WE NEED TO CANCEL THE RUN IMMEIDATELY. It takes 10mins on the Mac and at the rate its going on Kovacs -- with no resource contention -- its going to take >2 hours!?!?!', then 'The SLEEPS take more time (by a factor of 4 or 5) than the actual tests!' The suite's speed is fixed in this batch, superseding vc's call to leave it until after the release. The cause, as read: bats --jobs's within-file semaphore polls with sleep 1, and lib/bats-lanes sets N to half the CPUs, 2 on kovacs. The batch: cc takes the local leg's red, 2200's teardown race (releasecut.bats:2827), and 1150's guard as 0334's follow-up; dc takes the speed, measured on kovacs and rhadamanth before choosing. One stacked run proves all three, with TMPDIR shaped as a leg sets it. The re-cut waits for vc's 'ready'.
